purpose: Replicate a landed control bit on its existing read-capture edge, then replicate again on the existing core input-capture edge. No extra data edge is credited.

contract.reset_and_warm_age: Identical to local_r; copies capture the same selected/valid expression on the same edge, rather than capturing its registered output.
contract.synthesis_retention: Each output is an individually kept, uniquely parameterized one-bit flop hierarchy. Every group independently owns counter, warm, reset and onehot selector state. Actual synthesis retention must be measured.

logical_cost.parent_proposal_not_implemented: Three read-edge pre-copies feed at most 24 new same-edge core-input capture flops each. Those capture flops require explicitly allocated existing-depth reset leaves, actual producer port binding, and a recursive upstream/control census.

not_proven: Global LP reset source distribution: this component does not make a shared parent reset root bounded.
Actual parent consumer partitions, configuration enables, write priority and reset leaf assignment.
Native mapped area, clock entries, TT/FF phase/hold/setup, reset reach, pin access and routing.
Any additional transport or read-loop latency credit.
qualification: Compare every output against the unchanged local_r over nonperiodic input, two resets and destination phase -80/0/+80ps. A wrong-K mutant must fail. Synthesize retained hierarchy and audit physical data/control load counts separately from conservative all-combinational logical influence.
